limitations: Nine positive gallery examples from six games; not a random sample or a measurement of precision/recall.
Five examples confirmed brilliant in fresh Game Review; two historical gallery examples instead shown as inaccuracies; two further examples have gallery evidence only.
SF18 local search evidence is not Chess.com engine evidence, nor a full Mobile Maia/Mute Chess application pipeline replay.
The material calculation is a Python translation of the pinned reference; annotation decisions use the unchanged TypeScript oracle.

Three-position windows are searched forward with complete exact same-depth MultiPV results; hash is cleared before each budget comparison. Application prior-iteration/confirmation withholding is not replayed.
No player-rating curve, hidden sacrifice definition, or exact Chess.com thresholds can be recovered from this sample.
Mute v1 entries replay eligibility only, without claiming live same-iteration or independent-window confirmation. The sample was used to develop the policy, not held out.
